title: デビュー戦の後に・運命のレース

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yay! Trainer, see that? I got through the whole race. My lucky powers went to work right away! Sweet victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It sure was! It was like a path of light was guiding me on the turf, saying, "Come this way! Woof, woof!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've made my debut… But that means I'm only just getting started, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay, then. Please do me the honor of deciding the next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …That's probably what you expected me to say, right? But why don't we let divination do the work for us?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That's right! I guess you could say this is how I like to spice things up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay, here goes. Whatever it says on the fortune slip, that'll be my next race. It's all up to luck today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like our next goal is the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho! After running 2,000 meters through the Nakayama spring greenery, I'll emerge as a beautiful flower!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like our next goal is the Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Spring Stakes! Who will be first to cover those 1,800 meters in Nakayama and take the crown of budding flowers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like our next goal is the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Hai! A 1,800-meter race in Hanshin. Since it's a G3 race, it should be within reach. This is a chance to put all that everyday hard work to the test!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's go with that! Hehehe, I'm starting to get all pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's not arbitrary! We're not doing this for show, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We are following the will of the gods to the letter. Besides, you're the one who pulled the slip!
